The left eye had normal anterior segment but showed retinal hemorrhages. Further history revealed systemic symptoms—headache, fatigue, subjective fevers, and left foot erythema—that began 4 days prior. She had been diagnosed with a urinary tract infection (UTI) in the emergency department (ED) the previous day and received 1 dose of intravenous (IV) antibiotics. She denied recreational IV drug use.

  B. Ask about oral ulcers and perform fluorescein angiography

  D. Perform an anterior chamber tap, administer intravitreal antimicrobials, and transfer to the ED

- shards (list[str]): The clinician's reasoning decomposed into minimal, self-contained pieces of
  information ("shards") that support clinical_claim. They are disclosed across turns by the simulator.

  the previous state.

  converged on a shared plan/diagnosis and the clinician has no remaining objections or open questions.
